spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Clinical precision. High white space. Strict alignment. Optical clarity.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol B (Control Room) for Dashboard. High density, gap-4 to gap-6. Strict use of borders.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges or subtle roundness (rounded-md). Primary is bold orange, secondary is white with border-stone-200. No heavy gradients.
components.cards: White background, 1px border-stone-200, subtle shadow, rounded-lg. Clean padding (p-6).
components.inputs: Shadcn input but with focus-visible:ring-primary. Clean borders.
components.tables: Minimalist rows. No vertical borders. Generous padding per cell (py-4).
components.timeline: Custom vertical line with orange dots. Cards on the right detailing the consultation.
components.image_comparison: Hero feature. Two images side-by-side or slider, strict aspect ratio (e.g., 4:5 or 1:1), hover to zoom. Use object-cover.
components.toast: Use Sonner for notifications. Clean white background with subtle border.

motion.hover: Subtle border color change, bg tint change. Buttons scale down active state (scale-95).
motion.page_transition: framer-motion fade in and slide up (y: 10, opacity: 0 to 1).
motion.image_zoom: Transform scale-105 on hover for before/after galleries, transition-transform duration-500.

auth_background.description: Cosmetic serums and gels on a soft background, used for the left side of the login page.

auth_background_alt.description: Alternative abstract liquid texture for login background.

doctor_avatar.description: Female consultant avatar used in header/sidebar.

skin_before.description: Close up of skin, used in the consultation before/after gallery.

skin_after.description: Close up of skin, used in the consultation before/after gallery.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lucide-react, recharts, framer-motion, sonner, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Setup routing (e.g., react-router-dom) with paths for Login, Dashboard, Clients List, Client Profile, Add/Edit Client, Add Consultation, User Management, Audit Logs.
Implement JWT Auth (Login page) redirecting to Dashboard. Use 'auth_background' for a split-screen login design.
Create Dashboard with top KPI cards, search bar, and recent clients table.
Build Clients List page with search + complex filters (Skin concern, treatment type, date range).
Build Client Profile page. This is the core. It needs a header with personal info, a side panel or section for skin type/allergies/product history, and a large timeline view for consultations.
In the Client Profile, implement an Image Gallery for Before/After comparison. Build a side-by-side split view component for these images with hover zoom.
Add Consultation form needs a Date Picker (Shadcn Calendar), textarea for notes, multiple selection for products used, and an image upload area (mock the upload, just show preview).
Admin Audit logs page to track activities.
User management page for Admin role.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Avoid centered card layouts; use left-aligned, clinical data grids. Ensure generous padding in containers.
Use orange (#E35D3F) strictly as a functional accent for primary buttons, active tabs, and key data points. Do not overuse it to maintain the clinical trust.
